segments.tha-ap525:1.3: Nāvāya bhijjamānāya, bhikkhu me saraṇaṃ adā.
segments.tha-ap525:2.1: “Ekatiṃse ito kappe, yaṃ so me saraṇaṃ adā;
segments.tha-ap525:4.1: “Svāgataṃ vata me āsi … pe … kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ.
segments.tha-ap525:6.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā saraṇagamaniyo thero imā gāthāyo Abhāsitthāti.
